initial_ideas.name: cache_room_backgrounds
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Cache static room backgrounds between renders.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Avoid rebuilding unchanged room geometry while drawing dynamic objects normally.
additional_checks: exact pixels across multiple rooms, dark rooms, inventory and lava states

initial_ideas.name: render_final_two_game_states
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Render only the two held-action states needed for pooling.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Carry two game states through frame skipping instead of rendering every native frame.
additional_checks: exact early-game-over and final-two-frame pooling results

initial_ideas.name: unroll_four_frame_game_loop
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Unroll the fixed four-frame held-action loop.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Expose independent work within the native-frame loop to the compiler.

initial_ideas.name: nested_policy_environment_batching
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Compare nested and flat game-state batching.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Change batching layout without sharing state or weights across policy copies.

initial_ideas.name: fuse_pixel_preprocessing
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Fuse grayscale, maximum pooling, area resize and byte output.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Avoid intermediate image buffers while preserving the agreed preprocessing order.
initial_ideas.implementation_note: Requires a distinct preprocessing implementation, not an unchanged JIT wrapper.
additional_checks: exact uint8 observations on supplied native frames

implementation.note: Requires a distinct preprocessing implementation, not an unchanged JIT wrapper.

initial_ideas.name: combine_palette_and_sprite_drawing
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Use grayscale palette lookup after ordered sprite drawing.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Keep the original ordered palette-index rasterization, then use a precomputed grayscale palette to avoid creating an RGB intermediate image.
additional_checks: exact pixels for overlapping sprites and dynamic room objects

initial_ideas.name: store_rollout_observations_as_bytes
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Keep rollout observations as bytes until network input.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Reduce rollout storage and memory transfers relative to upstream float32 buffers.

initial_ideas.name: reconstruct_stacks_from_individual_frames
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Store individual frames and reconstruct reset-aware stacks.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Avoid storing four overlapping frames for every rollout row.
initial_ideas.implementation_note: The indexed bank inherently stores uint8 pixels: 2*T+8 frames per lane, rather than 4*T stacked frames. Both representation changes are recorded.
additional_checks: stack reconstruction across life loss, full reset and rollout boundaries

implementation.note: The indexed bank inherently stores uint8 pixels: 2*T+8 frames per lane, rather than 4*T stacked frames. Both representation changes are recorded.

initial_ideas.name: circular_frame_stack
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Replace frame-stack concatenation with a circular buffer.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Move stack indices rather than repeatedly copying earlier frames.
initial_ideas.implementation_note: Compare canonical chronological frames; the physical circular representation differs.
additional_checks: exact network-visible chronological stacks after every reset

implementation.note: Compare canonical chronological frames; the physical circular representation differs.

initial_ideas.name: fuse_minibatch_image_preparation
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Fuse minibatch gather, image conversion and normalization.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Read selected image bytes once before producing normalized network inputs.

initial_ideas.name: donate_training_buffers
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Donate old learner buffers for reuse.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Permit reuse of parameter, optimizer and environment allocations.

initial_ideas.name: recompute_network_activations
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Recompute selected activations during differentiation.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Exchange repeated arithmetic for smaller saved activation buffers.

initial_ideas.name: channels_last_convolutions
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Compare channels-first and channels-last convolutions.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Change convolution layout while retaining original float32 weights and outputs.

initial_ideas.name: group_independent_convolutions
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Compare vectorized and grouped independent convolutions.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Give the compiler one grouped operation with separate weights for every policy.

initial_ideas.name: einsum_independent_dense_layers
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Compare equivalent dense-layer batch operations.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Change matrix batching without mixing policy parameters or rows.

initial_ideas.name: fuse_network_bias_and_activation
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Fuse network bias and activation with linear operations.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Remove intermediate network arrays if the reference compiler has not already done so.
initial_ideas.implementation_note: An existing compiler fusion alone is not a distinct measured candidate.

implementation.note: An existing compiler fusion alone is not a distinct measured candidate.

initial_ideas.name: cache_frozen_training_target_features
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Cache frozen RND training targets within one update.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Reuse targets on current frames under updated observation statistics across minibatches.
additional_checks: current training frames and updated statistics; predictor recomputed each step

initial_ideas.name: batch_rollout_intrinsic_rewards
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Calculate rollout intrinsic rewards after collection.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Batch next-frame RND calculations using unchanged parameters and pre-rollout statistics.

initial_ideas.name: flat_parameter_and_optimizer_buffers
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Keep per-policy parameters and moments in flat update buffers.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Pack once across all minibatches, retaining independent per-policy clipping.

initial_ideas.name: fuse_gradient_clipping_and_adam
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Fuse per-policy gradient norm, clipping and Adam work.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Combine elementwise optimizer work within each minibatch.

initial_ideas.name: single_sixteen_minibatch_scan
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Run all sixteen minibatch updates in one compiled loop.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Flatten the epoch and minibatch loops while retaining each epoch's permutation.
initial_ideas.implementation_note: The reference already compiles nested loops; a second JIT wrapper is not a candidate.

implementation.note: The reference already compiles nested loops; a second JIT wrapper is not a candidate.

initial_ideas.name: unroll_minibatch_update_loop
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Tune update-loop unrolling.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Expose adjacent minibatch work without changing its order or number of updates.

initial_ideas.name: gather_epoch_minibatches_in_advance
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Compare on-demand and pre-gathered minibatches.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Prepare an epoch's independent policy minibatches before scanning updates.

initial_ideas.name: associative_advantage_scan
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Compare reverse and associative advantage calculations.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Use parallel composition of the same discounted recurrences without changing masks.

initial_ideas.name: separate_rollout_and_update_compilation
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Compare one compiled iteration with separate compiled phases.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Limit compilation regions while retaining the same rollout, preparation and update.

initial_ideas.name: unroll_policy_rollout_loop
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Tune the 128-step policy rollout loop's unrolling.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Expose adjacent policy rollout work while retaining every transition.

initial_ideas.name: group_complete_training_iterations
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Run several complete iterations in one compiled call.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Reduce host dispatches while preserving iteration counters and annealing positions.

initial_ideas.name: batch_quantity_keyed_random_generation
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Batch random draws using the same quantity-specific keys.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Reduce repeated random-generation dispatch without shifting any existing stream.
additional_checks: identical action, permutation and predictor-mask keys

initial_ideas.name: accumulate_scheduled_reports_on_device
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Accumulate scheduled reports and episode summaries on the GPU.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Read reports only when due while preserving their window positions and totals.
initial_ideas.implementation_note: A separate driver-overhead comparison: both variants emit the same rows; the reference downloads every update and the candidate downloads only the window.

implementation.note: A separate driver-overhead comparison: both variants emit the same rows; the reference downloads every update and the candidate downloads only the window.

initial_ideas.name: combine_running_statistic_reductions
initial_ideas.hypothesis: Combine normalization reductions and running-statistic updates.
initial_ideas.mechanism: Compute equivalent float64 moments without changing source axes, counts or update order.
additional_checks: float64 moment comparison under large means and small variance
